request.body:
## Result and scope

Refs #336

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/336#issuecomment-6868695020, session `ADB991-claude-20261114-37f8`.
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026 (C15). New `manuscript/existence/trace-rounded-comparison.tex`; in `manuscript/existence/trace-asymptotic.tex` only the `\input` and the one status sentence after `input:trace-scales`; new evidence directory `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C15/ADB991-claude-20261114-37f8/`.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

New subsection `subsec:trace-rounded-comparison`, the producer of `eq:trace-basis-error`. It follows `YM.Trace.Verse.seat`.

**What it establishes.** All of this is conditional on (G1)–(G4) and (Ph1)–(Ph3), which the subsection lists.
- `prop:trace-rounded-comparison`: for a fixed grade d, all large i (threshold depends only on d), every basis pair and every fit x whose rounding q = m_i^{-1}⌈m_i x⌉ lies in the window,
  |S_χ(U_i e, U_i e'; r_i q) − S_0(e, e'; q)| ≤ ε_i(1 + |S_0(e;q_0)| + |S_0(e';q_1)|), with ε_i = 1/(i+1).
- `cor:trace-rounded-input`: the pointwise, continuity and window clauses of `input:trace-scales`, with M_{αβ}(q) = |S_0(e_α;q_0)| + |S_0(e_β;q_1)|, plus q_i(x) → x and the neighbourhood of x(t).
- `lem:trace-rounded-conjugate`: M(w̄) = M(w)^* from phase reality and the separating vacuum (Lean `Verse.conj_M`). This supplies `eq:episode-conjugate`, which `actual-phase-detector-moments.tex` takes as an input, in this setting.

**Proof route.** No new heavy machinery is needed; the proof reuses results already in the manuscript.
- The cumulant-corrected receipt parts are proved in place.
- The polynomial-packet argument of `sec:actual-phase-detector-moments` (planted inequality, then point limits, then separated clusters) gives the all-power moment bounds.
- `ex-character-moments` and the two-point calculation in `phase-fields.tex` finish the estimate.
- The rounding estimate and the window are proved directly.

**What remains open (main point for review).** The only quantitative input is (G3), the pairwise root-test receipt. In Lean it is `SeqPair.boot`/`width` at cost `costHint i`, coming from `await` → `lava_vSky`/`earningsSky` and `Ship.diminishes`.
- `trace-firesky-gallery.tex` records it as part of the one-step chart output and attributes it to `sec:three-panel-weak-comparison`.
- That section, however, takes the grid comparison as its own input (`eq:three-grid`) and states no root-test bound.
- **No manuscript producer of (G3) was located.** It is stated as an open input, with its exact content.
- First unsupported implication: from the chart supply to `eq:trace-rounded-receipt-one/two` for all basis pairs, N > k_i, all p, and fit x with rounding in the window.
- A separate task to explain `lava_vSky`/`earningsSky` is suggested.
